name: Thushar
tagline: Building things, breaking things, learning from both
bio: I'm Thushar, a CSE (AI) undergraduate at TKMCE. I like taking things apart to see how they work, then building my own versions, from a machine learning model that spots fake product reviews to PaLO, an offline study app. When I'm not coding, I'm reading, usually something with a good story.

projects.title: Fake product review analyzer
projects.desc: Machine learning project that uses an SVM classifier to flag product reviews as fake or genuine.

projects.title: PaLO
projects.desc: A desktop study app that works fully offline, built to help people learn and revise more effectively.

projects.title: Voice for Bharat by murf ai
projects.desc: AI-powered tutor built for the Voice for Bharat challenge, using the Murf AI voice API.
